rationale: Covers all 11 required sections, keeps the three planes distinct, and aligns tightly with FACTS.md using consistent EXISTS/EXTEND/CONFIG/NEW tagging plus a full assumption file, so no capability is invented. Security is strong: three-layer fail-closed enforcement, tenant predicates inside vector queries, DB-grant-backed audit and operator scope, deny-by-default tests. Work packages are bounded with definitions of done and explicit sequencing. Deductions for placeholder targets, repetitive classification restatements, some unverified assumptions, and the truncated final assumption line.
